Direction for questions :

Eight people Aman, Binay, Charul, Dhaval, Eric, Fred, Ganesh, and Harry are sitting around a circular table. Aman and Binay are facing toward the center while the other six people are facing opposite the center. Charul is not an immediate neighbor of Dhaval. Aman sits second to the right of Harry. Binay sits third to the left of Aman. Harry is sitting between Dhaval and Ganesh. Ganesh is the immediate neighbor of neither Binay nor Aman. Eric and Fred are immediate neighbors of each other.

Which of the following pairs represents the people who are immediate neighbors of Charul?
